players.name: Rowan Vale
players.purpose: Moves the defense, then moves the puck.

pressure.name: Draw & slip
pressure.detail: When the forechecker commits, releases behind the first pressure.

pressure.name: Reverse escape
pressure.detail: Against wall pressure, pivots toward the reverse outlet.

pressure.name: Hold & scan
pressure.detail: When lanes close, holds below the goal line for support.

pressure.name: Early rim
pressure.detail: When the middle is sealed, sends around the wall before contact.

skills.name: PP distribution
skills.detail: Finds the next touch from the high point.

skills.name: Controlled exits
skills.detail: Links a low retrieval to a controlled advance.

skills.name: Seam feeds
skills.detail: Delivers through the middle to a moving target.

skills.name: Entry denial
skills.detail: Challenges the receiver at the defensive blue line.

skills.name: Weak-side support
skills.detail: Offers the far-side outlet behind the first pressure.

skills.name: Outlet reception
skills.detail: Receives on the move with a forward option available.

skills.name: Point-shot setup
skills.detail: Creates a release lane from a high puck reception.

skills.name: Rim retrieval
skills.detail: Collects a wall puck with the next outlet in view.

methods: Shows the wall; finds the middle.
Changes the shooting and passing lane.
Feeds the center before pressure arrives.
players.assignment: D1 · PP1 point. Activate when the weak side covers.
players.links: Partner holds the middle; center offers the low outlet.
players.limitations: Less effective shooting through heavy traffic.
players.distinctive: Changes the angle before the defense resets.
questions: Does the first forechecker take away the middle?

players.name: Mika North
players.purpose: Stays available for the next threat.

pressure.name: Lateral patience
pressure.detail: Against a cross-slot threat, delays the push until release.

pressure.name: Traffic windows
pressure.detail: When screened, changes the sightline before the shot.

pressure.name: Second-shot reset
pressure.detail: After a loose save, resets toward the next live threat.

pressure.name: Safe wall leave
pressure.detail: With a forechecker closing, leaves to visible defensive support.

skills.name: Rebound placement
skills.detail: Directs a playable save away from the immediate second threat.

skills.name: Behind-net exchanges
skills.detail: Sets the puck for a defender's low retrieval.

skills.name: Post integration
skills.detail: Connects the post seal to the next puck angle.

skills.name: Screen tracking
skills.detail: Tracks the release through changing traffic.

skills.name: Lateral recovery
skills.detail: Re-establishes a usable set after crossing the crease.

skills.name: Rim interception
skills.detail: Stops a wall puck before it reaches the retrieval corner.

skills.name: Outlet receiving
skills.detail: Controls a return puck before a short exchange.

skills.name: Rush depth
skills.detail: Sets depth for the visible rush options.

methods: Finds the next threat after first contact.
Leaves a clean puck for the retrieval.
players.assignment: Starter. Set depth to the puck; delay before lateral commitment.
players.links: Near defender retrieves the leave; far defender provides the reverse.
players.limitations: Long outlets under pressure are less reliable.
players.distinctive: Recovers into the next play with minimal extra movement.
questions: Is the receiver visible before the exchange?
Can the defense clear the second shot?

players.name: Ellis Rook
players.purpose: Turns pressure and retrievals into a second attack.

pressure.name: Wall shield
pressure.detail: Against close contact, protects the puck on the outside hip.

pressure.name: One-touch release
pressure.detail: As the outlet window closes, redirects to nearby support.

pressure.name: Chip & pursue
pressure.detail: Against a sealed carry route, sends to space and follows.

pressure.name: Inside recovery
pressure.detail: After a lost puck, recovers inside before closing again.

skills.name: First pressure
skills.detail: Angles the retrieval toward the unit's support.

skills.name: Wall retrievals
skills.detail: Converts a contested wall puck into a playable outlet.

skills.name: Counterpressure
skills.detail: Re-engages a loose exchange before the opponent can reset.

skills.name: Net-front screens
skills.detail: Times the lane occupation to a teammate's release.

skills.name: Short support
skills.detail: Offers a close continuation under a forecheck.

skills.name: PK pursuit
skills.detail: Closes the next exchange while keeping the inside lane.

skills.name: Defensive wall work
skills.detail: Helps a low retrieval reach the next support option.

skills.name: Change-time advances
skills.detail: Sends deep to permit a supported line change.

methods: Arrives from inside to shape the next outlet.
Frees the puck for nearby support.
Joins the net-front lane as the shot develops.
players.assignment: F1 on the selected forecheck; recover inside when pressure is beaten.
players.links: Center supplies the short outlet; weak-side winger protects the middle.
players.limitations: Less reliable on long seam deliveries from a standing start.
players.distinctive: Keeps a broken play alive long enough for the unit to reconnect.
questions: Who takes F1 after the handoff?
Is there support for the second pursuit?
